notes.title: Endless Mode Update
notes.content:
[h1]Procedural Levels[/h1]
Completing the base levels now unlocks [b]Endless Mode[/b]! This mode allows you to generate a set of 30 levels that roughly increase in difficulty. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/d562478672bafce1ac91774af0d4251574558952.gif[/img]

You can re-generate levels any time you like, such as when you've completed the current set or are stuck on a level and want a fresh start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/8a108b73d0f974c556aa324c31815c93c1267b52.gif[/img]

As a bonus Endless Mode includes some [b]new level grids[/b] not seen in the base levels! There's also a [b]new Steam achievement[/b] for completing a set of Endless levels.

[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
[h2]UI visibility[/h2]
For those prefer a more relaxing experience you may enjoy the new [b]Hide UI[/b] button. You can now get rid of the clutter in the top UI and focus purely on the gameplay itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/d8f22204ebdf0bc49d79f99c78d7a0ad99a84a27.gif[/img]

[h2]Active level indicator[/h2]
The level select screen now highlights which level you just came from.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/c15bfbcbb4ac3f2c70cfb18edbd385b01cc14a4c.png[/img]

[h2]Previous/next level shortcuts[/h2]
Clearing a set of levels, whether it's the base levels or a set of endless levels, now unlocks next and previous level shortcuts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43047622/84821952501f774c2ae97c9cbbe3fb9337d29b4e.gif[/img]

[h3]Thanks for playing![/h3]

notes.title: V1.01
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added an exit button to the game with an on-hover tooltip that lets players know the game will save on exit. [i]The game already auto-saved even on a force close (ie. alt+f4) but I added this explicit button so first-time players aren't confused about whether or not the game will save if they exit[/i]
[*] Fixed a bug with the level select button not being clickable when it first unlocks and requiring a game restart to become clickable
[/list]
